description.name: Paymos
description.tagline: Accept Paymos crypto payments from WHMCS invoices.
description.long: Paymos redirects WHMCS clients to hosted checkout, verifies signed webhooks, reverse-verifies terminal events with the Paymos API, and reconciles missed payments through WHMCS cron.
features: Hosted Paymos Checkout for WHMCS invoices
Reverse API verification before payment capture
